From the menu

A short menu: souvlaki in Cyprus pita, portions from the grill with chips and salad, fresh fish and salads. Pita dishes at lunchtime until 17:00. Prices at the restaurant.

In Cyprus pita with salad

  • Pork kebab
  • Mixed pork kebab and sheftalia
  • Sheftalia
  • Chicken kebab
  • Halloumi or mushrooms in pita

Portions with chips and salad

  • Kebab, pork or chicken
  • Pork chops, 500 g or 700 g
  • Lamb chops
  • Chicken breast
  • Grilled halloumi
  • Pork belly strips

Mixed grill and fish

  • Mixed grill: pork and chicken kebab, loukaniko, sheftalia, pork belly, pastourma, halloumi and mushrooms
  • Mixed grill for two
  • Fresh fish with chips and salad

Salads and sides

  • Greek salad
  • Village salad with rocket
  • Halloumi, mushrooms, pastourma, loukaniko and sheftalia as sides
  • Chips, feta, yogurt and olives

At ELIYA

Photos from the restaurant’s Google listing.

A table opposite the church

ELIYA Souvlaki is at Ayiou Lazarou 20 in Larnaca, opposite the church of Agios Lazaros, with tables inside and on the square outside. The menu is short: souvlaki and sheftalia in Cyprus pita, portions from the grill, a mixed grill, fresh fish and salads. In the reviews guests mention the view of the church, the mixed grill and the halloumi, and several write about extra pita, olives or fruit brought to the table on the house.

Today ELIYA has no website of its own: the Google listing shows no website. Checked on 23 September 2026.

What guests say

From the Google listing, 4.8 stars on average across 268 reviews.

“A lovely place with an authentic Cypriot atmosphere. The location is nice and reflects the local tradition. The food was delicious, and everything felt fresh and well-prepared. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome throughout our visit. Highly recommended!”

Google review
“Highly recommend Eliya Restaurant for an authentic experience. The service is excellent and the food delicious. It was the best taverna we experienced in Cyprus. Excellent value for money: fresh product, big portions, meze on the house.”

Google review
“Amazing food and very generous portions! We also received extra pita bread and fresh fruit, which was a lovely surprise. We couldn’t have asked for a better place during our stay in Larnaca. Highly recommend!”

Google review
“We had a really lovely evening and meal. We shared a number of dishes including a greek salad. Good portion size and quality ingredients. The service was friendly. Great location overlooking the square and church. We can't wait to come back.”
